name: PediatricWellChildVisit
title: Pediatric Well-Child Visit
description: Completed by a parent or guardian before their child's routine check-up.

extension.valueMarkdown: Milestone, feeding and safety questions follow the age group the parent picks. Milestones are a conversation starter, not a developmental screening instrument.

item.text: Please fill in this form before your child's check-up. Answer for how your child is now.
